name: Gold cup Electric Apparatus Co.,Ltd.
summary: Gold cup Electric Apparatus Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells flat magnet wires and cables in China and internationally. It offers electrical equipment wire, including flexible cable and wire, screened cable, low smoke halogen free flame retardant wire, exquisite flame retardant wire, high-end easy home wire, radiated European standard wire, computer cable, and plastics insulated and sheathed control cable products.
